statements.t: • Rigel continues to advance its Phase 1b clinical study of R289 1 , a potent and selective dual inhibitor of interleukin receptor-associated kinases 1 and 4 (IRAK1/4), in patients with relapsed or refractory (R/R) lower-risk myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS) and the company expects to complete enrollment and select the recommended Phase 2 dose for future development by the end of 2026.
The company also continues to anticipate it will report positive net income for the full year 2026, while funding existing and new clinical development programs.
